name: AXM Text Fabric
purpose: Local-first modular typography, text-effects, readability, accessibility, and platform adaptation system for games, websites, apps, and software.
principles: semantic text roles before one-off sizes
effects may enhance hierarchy but may not erase legibility
user scaling and localization are first-class
no bundled proprietary or system font files
deterministic output, inspectable decisions, reversible configuration
dependencies: Python 3.10+ standard library only; web demo has no build step.
font_policy: No font binaries included. Use licensed project fonts or platform/system stacks.
notes: Expanded material finishes and special text-effect recipes for neon, gold, silver, chrome, and holographic treatments.
Added readable futuristic glitch text mode with safety guardrails and a subtle RGB/channel-offset effect for hero text and premium HUD elements.
Added engine-native shader/material direction pack for Unity, Unreal, and Godot.
Added starter material parameters for gold, chrome, neon, holographic, and readable glitch text.
Added searchable preset gallery with 24 inspectable starting configurations and machine-facing preset resolution.
Added local-only preset favorites, favorites filtering, CSS/JSON copy, and JSON download.
Added adaptive render-cost budgets for low, balanced, high, and cinematic quality tiers.
Added local custom preset save/import/delete workflow in the standalone browser.
Added deterministic multi-platform preset compilation with hashes and rollback-friendly bundle manifests.
Added auto-detected preset-or-recipe compilation with friendly error handling and suggestions.
Compiled bundles now include import-ready starter structures for web, Unity, Unreal, and Godot.
Added source snapshots, lock files, bundle verification, tamper detection, and batch library compilation.
Added dependency-free Unicode script, direction, hidden-control, and fallback-font auditing.
Added portable SVG fallback generation from the same resolved plans used by engine exports.
Added optional verified PNG baking through Inkscape, rsvg-convert, or ImageMagick.
Added reproducible quality-tier visual QA matrices with hashed assets and manifests.
Added dependency-free TTF, OTF, and TTC table inspection without bundling font binaries.
Added actual glyph coverage gates, variable-font axis detection, shaping capability inspection, and license metadata reporting.
Added local metadata-only font registries and deterministic fallback-stack planning for mixed-language text.
Compiled bundles redact local font paths while preserving hashes and coverage reports.
Added deterministic layout overflow estimation, pseudo-localization, RTL stress, safe-area guidance, and viewing-distance floors.
Compiled bundles now include layout audits and pseudo-localization samples.
Added a standalone layout stress laboratory and offline layout QA matrix generator.
